The commercial requirement

Vehicle care built around the work.

Weather, access, drainage and limited lighting can prevent a mobile detailer from completing a demanding job consistently. The Auto Opulence studio brings washing, inspection and finishing into one indoor Norwich workspace.

Trade detailers can select a three-hour session, full working day or full day with overnight access. This makes the bay suitable for focused valeting, machine polishing and coating projects where the vehicle needs professional facilities or time indoors before collection.

  • Three-hour trade sessions
  • Full-day bookings
  • Day and overnight access
  • Pressure washing, extraction and polishing equipment
01

Weather-independent work

An indoor environment removes interruptions from rain, wind and strong outdoor heat while keeping the vehicle in one working area.

02

Professional inspection

Wall and overhead lighting support paint assessment, machine polishing and final finish checks throughout the job.

03

Flexible working time

Choose a compact three-hour session, full-day access or a day-and-overnight booking for longer processes and curing time.

Every enquiry starts with the vehicles, the operating requirement and the result your business needs.

  3. 03

  4. 04

    Finish the project within the reserved access period and return the bay and supplied equipment in the agreed condition.

Trade Detailers FAQs

Planning the work.

Who can book trade valet bay hire?

Trade hire is intended for professional detailers, valeters and automotive businesses. Private customers should use the public bay-hire options.

What trade hire periods are available?

Choose a three-hour trade session for £50, a full trade day for £140, or a full trade day with overnight access for £170. Availability must be confirmed before arrival.

What is included in the detailing studio?

The facility includes an indoor wash bay, floor drainage, Kranzle K7 pressure washer, inline spotless water and professional inspection lighting. Confirm extraction, polishing and other equipment requirements when booking.

Can a ceramic-coated vehicle stay overnight?

Day-and-overnight hire can suit work requiring additional indoor time, subject to booking terms. The vehicle must be collected by 8:30am the following morning unless another arrangement is confirmed.

Can I bring my own detailing products?

Yes. Trade users can bring their preferred products and consumables. Discuss any specialist equipment, electrical load or access requirement before the booking.
